faqs.question: What are DBS branch operating hours?
faqs.answer: Most DBS branches operate Monday to Friday from 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM, and Saturday from 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.

faqs.question: Are DBS branches open on public holidays?
faqs.answer: No, DBS branches are closed on Singapore public holidays. Digital banking services remain available 24/7.

faqs.question: How do I find the nearest DBS branch or ATM?
faqs.answer: You can find nearby DBS branches and ATMs using the DBS digibank app or by asking me to locate one based on your area.

faqs.question: What are the credit card annual fees?
faqs.answer: DBS Altitude Card: $196.20/year, DBS Woman's World Card: $192.60/year, DBS Yuu Card: $0 (waived permanently).

faqs.question: Are annual fees waived for the first year?
faqs.answer: Most DBS credit cards offer a first-year annual fee waiver, subject to card type and ongoing promotions.

faqs.question: How can I request a credit card fee waiver?
faqs.answer: You can request an annual fee waiver through DBS digibank, live chat, or by calling customer support.

faqs.question: How do I lock my credit card?
faqs.answer: You can lock your credit card instantly through our chat by saying 'lock my card', via the DBS mobile app, or by calling our hotline at 1800-111-1111.

faqs.question: What should I do if my card is lost or stolen?
faqs.answer: Immediately lock your card via digibank or chat. You may then request a replacement card to be delivered to your registered address.

faqs.question: Will locking my card cancel recurring payments?
faqs.answer: No, locking your card blocks new transactions but does not cancel existing recurring or subscription payments.

faqs.question: What is the minimum balance for savings accounts?
faqs.answer: DBS Multiplier Account requires a minimum of $1,000 to avoid fall-below fees. Some basic savings accounts have no minimum balance requirement.

faqs.question: What happens if my balance falls below the minimum?
faqs.answer: A fall-below fee may be charged depending on your account type. Refer to your specific account terms for details.

faqs.question: How can I transfer money to another bank?
faqs.answer: Use PayNow for instant transfers, FAST for same-day transfers, or GIRO for scheduled transfers via DBS digibank or chat.

faqs.question: Is PayNow available 24/7?
faqs.answer: Yes, PayNow transfers are available 24/7, including weekends and public holidays.

faqs.question: Are there fees for bank transfers?
faqs.answer: PayNow and FAST transfers are generally free for retail customers. GIRO transfers may have applicable fees depending on setup.

faqs.question: How do I reset my digibank password?
faqs.answer: You can reset your password through the DBS digibank app or website using your registered mobile number and OTP.

faqs.question: What should I do if I suspect fraudulent activity?
faqs.answer: Lock the affected card or account immediately and contact DBS customer support for further assistance.

faqs.question: How can I update my contact details?
faqs.answer: You can update your mobile number, email, or address via DBS digibank under Profile Settings.

faqs.question: How long does it take to update personal details?
faqs.answer: Most contact detail updates take effect immediately, while address changes may take up to one business day.

policies.content: Customers can lock or unlock cards instantly. Locking prevents new transactions but does not cancel existing recurring payments.
Daily transfer limit: $50,000 for online banking and chat-based actions, $200,000 for in-branch transactions. Bill payment limit: $9,999 per transaction.
Sensitive actions require user authentication via OTP, biometric verification, or digibank login confirmation.
DBS continuously monitors transactions for suspicious activity and may temporarily restrict accounts for customer protection.
Customer data is protected under Singapore’s PDPA and DBS internal security policies. Chat interactions are logged for audit and quality purposes.
